basics.label: Sophomore Mechanical Engineering and Material Sicence Student
basics.summary: A South Korean student studying mechanical and materials engineering at HMC with hands-on and research experience, and a passion for automotives, aerospace, robotics, consumable tech, and design.

education.institution: Harvey Mudd College, Claremont, CA, USA

work.name: SEW Eurodrive, Suzhou, China
work.summary: At SEW Eurodrive’s Suzhou plant, I closely observed the assembly of DRN series starting motors and gearboxes, gaining hands-on insight into the production process. By analyzing data and working with engineers, I contributed to improving assembly efficiency and product quality.
highlights: Observed assembly of starting motors and gearboxes, mapping 15+ process steps to identify redundant or time-consuming tasks

Collected and categorized defect data from 500+ DRN series parts by inspecting assemblies alongside quality engineers, enabling targeted corrective actions that reduced minor defects by 7% and improved first-pass yield by 5%

Compared technical drawings and assembly instructions for DRN series components against actual practices; worked with engineers to identify discrepancies and update documents, reducing assembly errors by 8%
Compiled production and quality data into weekly Excel reports, highlighting trends and presenting actionable solutions to management.

projects.name: Hybrid-Powered Go-Kart - Mudd Automotive Club
projects.summary: Engineered a hybrid-powered go-kart integrating a Yamaha SRX 440 IC engine with four 12V electric motors, enabling combined power delivery and regenerative braking.
highlights: Designed and fabricated chassis using TIG welding of 4130 chromoly steel tubing for high strength-to-weight ratio
Machined precision aluminum 6061 brackets via CNC to ensure tight mechanical tolerances and secure component mounting
Applied SOLIDWORKS for detailed 3D modeling, assembly simulations, and technical drawing generation
Integrated hybrid drivetrain control for seamless transition between internal combustion engine and electric motor power

projects.name: Universal Antenna Remounting System - E4 Engineering Project
projects.summary: Designed and prototyped a universal antenna remounting system for satellite and drone GPS tracking, enabling precise integration with a motorized telescope mount.
highlights: Engineered system to achieve ±0.1mm positional accuracy using GD&T-compliant tolerancing
Developed antenna brackets via SolidWorks, optimizing for lightweight CFRP 3D printed parts and high-strength CNC-machined aluminum components
Managed project schedule and team coordination using Gantt charts, daily stand-ups, and detailed meeting documentation
Prototyped and tested mounting system ensuring seamless, repeatable repositioning for enhanced GPS tracking reliability

projects.name: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Marker Dropper - Mudd Sub
projects.summary: Designed and fabricated a butterfly-shaped rotating marker dropper mechanism for an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle competing in the international RoboSub competition.
highlights: Developed CAD models of the marker dropper in SolidWorks, applying precise mechanical drawings to ensure compatibility with AUV chassis and competition constraints
Prototyped components via FDM 3D printing using PLA and PETG materials to balance buoyancy and durability under underwater conditions
Performed iterative testing in pool environments to validate release timing, minimize hydrodynamic drag, and ensure repeatable performance
